info.title: Junction API
info.description: REST API for Junction, the Class 4 softswitch. Authenticate with a bearer token from Settings → API tokens. Each operation lists the token ability it needs (x-ability). Money is a decimal string; times are UTC ISO 8601. Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per token.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the required ability (or is a customer token)

available_funds.description: What routing sees now: balance + credit - calls in progress - unposted usage

dialing_scope.description: Where the customer may call: nanp = Canada and the USA only (the default for new accounts), international = anywhere, countries = Canada/USA plus dialing_countries.

dialing_countries.description: Country codes allowed with dialing_scope=countries (ISO 3166 two-letter codes; XS = satellite and global services).

is_customer.description: An account is either a customer or a carrier (is_vendor), never both.

is_vendor.description: Carrier: we send traffic to them. Never together with is_customer.
